(* ************************** *)
(* *****  Information   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)
M$ModelName = "B-L-SM_gen";

M$Information = {
  Authors      -> {"S. Amrith", "J. M. Butterworth", "F. F. Deppisch", "W. Liu", "A. Varma", "D. Yallup"},
  Version      -> "1.0",
  Date         -> "24.09.2026",
  Institutions -> {"UCL"},
  Emails       -> {"shyam.amrith.14@ucl.ac.uk", "j.butterworth@ucl.ac.uk", "f.deppisch@ucl.ac.uk", "wei.liu.16@ucl.ac.uk", "abhinav.varma.17@ucl.ac.uk", "david.yallup.15@ucl.ac.uk"},
  URLs         -> "https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.11452",
  References   -> {"arXiv:1811.11452"}
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *** Interaction orders *** *)
(* ************************** *)
M$InteractionOrderHierarchy = {
  {QCD, 1},
  {QED, 2},
  {NP,  1}
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****  Gauge groups  ***** *)
(* ************************** *)
(* New U(1)_{B-L} gauge group added on top of SM.fr *)
M$GaugeGroups = {
  U1BL == { 
    Abelian          -> True,  
    CouplingConstant -> g1p, 
    GaugeBoson       -> Zp, 
    Charge           -> BL
  }
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****    Indices     ***** *)
(* ************************** *)
(* All indices (Colour, Gluon, Generation, SU2D, SU2W) are declared in SM.fr.
   No new indices needed for B-L model (no colour sextets, etc.) *)

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Parameters   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)
M$Parameters = {

  (* External parameters - new physics *)
  
  g1p == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 1, 
    Value            -> 0.2, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> Subscript[g, BL], 
    Description      -> "U(1)_{B-L} gauge coupling"
  },
  
  MZp == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 2, 
    Value            -> 7000., 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> Subscript[M, Zp], 
    Description      -> "Z' boson mass [GeV]"
  },
  
  MH2 == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 3, 
    Value            -> 200., 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> Subscript[M, h2], 
    Description      -> "Second Higgs mass eigenstate mass [GeV]"
  },
  
  SA == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 4, 
    Value            -> 0.2, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> Sin[\[Alpha]], 
    Description      -> "Sine of the Higgs mixing angle alpha"
  },
  
  MNR == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 5, 
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]}, 
    Value            -> {1400., 1400., 1400.}, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> Subscript[M, N], 
    Description      -> "Heavy (right-handed) neutrino masses [GeV]"
  },
  
  Vln == { 
    ParameterType    -> External, 
    BlockName        -> BLINPUTS, 
    OrderBlock       -> 6, 
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]}, 
    Value            -> {1.e-6, 1.e-6, 1.e-6}, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> V_{lN}, 
    Description      -> "Active-sterile neutrino mixing V_{lN} = sin(theta_nu)"
  },

  (* Internal parameters - derived from external ones *)
  
  x == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> MZp/(2*g1p), 
    TeX           -> x, 
    Description   -> "B-L breaking VEV = <chi> = MZp/(2*g1p) [GeV]"
  },
  
  CA == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> Sqrt[1 - SA^2], 
    TeX           -> Cos[\[Alpha]], 
    Description   -> "Cosine of the Higgs mixing angle alpha"
  },
  
  lambda1 == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> (1/(4*vev^2))*((MH^2 + MH2^2) - CA*(MH2^2 - MH^2)), 
    TeX           -> \[Lambda]_1, 
    Description   -> "Quartic coupling lambda1 from Eq. (2.11)"
  },
  
  lambda2 == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> (1/(4*x^2))*((MH^2 + MH2^2) + CA*(MH2^2 - MH^2)), 
    TeX           -> \[Lambda]_2, 
    Description   -> "Quartic coupling lambda2 from Eq. (2.11)"
  },
  
  lambda3 == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> (1/(2*vev*x))*(2*SA*CA*(MH2^2 - MH^2)), 
    TeX           -> \[Lambda]_3, 
    Description   -> "Quartic coupling lambda3 from Eq. (2.11)"
  },
  
  muChi == { 
    ParameterType -> Internal, 
    Value         -> Sqrt[2*lambda2]*x, 
    TeX           -> \[Mu]_\chi, 
    Description   -> "Chi quadratic coefficient from potential"
  },

  (* Yukawa couplings for neutrinos - derived from seesaw *)
  (* y_nu = sqrt(2) * M_D / v, with M_D = V_lN * M_N (Type-I seesaw) *)
  ynu == { 
    ParameterType    -> Internal, 
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]}, 
    Definitions      -> {ynu[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ] :> 0 /; (i =!= j)}, 
    Value            -> {ynu[1,1] -> Sqrt[2]*Vln[1]*MNR[1]/vev, 
                         ynu[2,2] -> Sqrt[2]*Vln[2]*MNR[2]/vev, 
                         ynu[3,3] -> Sqrt[2]*Vln[3]*MNR[3]/vev}, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> y^\nu, 
    Description      -> "Dirac neutrino Yukawa couplings from seesaw"
  },
  
  yM == { 
    ParameterType    -> Internal, 
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation], Index[Generation]}, 
    Definitions      -> {yM[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ] :> 0 /; (i =!= j)}, 
    Value            -> {yM[1,1] -> MNR[1]/(Sqrt[2]*x), 
                         yM[2,2] -> MNR[2]/(Sqrt[2]*x), 
                         yM[3,3] -> MNR[3]/(Sqrt[2]*x)}, 
    InteractionOrder -> {NP, 1}, 
    TeX              -> y^M, 
    Description      -> "Majorana Yukawa couplings: M_N = sqrt(2) y^M x"
  }
};

(* ************************** *)
(* **** Particle classes **** *)
(* ************************** *)
M$ClassesDescription = {

  (* Physical vector boson: Z' *)
  V[100] == { 
    ClassName       -> Zp, 
    SelfConjugate   -> True,  
    Mass            -> {MZp, 7000.},  
    Width           -> {WZp, 0.},  
    ParticleName    -> "Zp", 
    PDG             -> 32, 
    PropagatorLabel -> "Zp", 
    PropagatorType  -> Sine, 
    PropagatorArrow -> None, 
    FullName        -> "Zprime"
  },

  (* Physical scalar: h2 (second Higgs mass eigenstate) *)
  S[100] == { 
    ClassName       -> h2, 
    SelfConjugate   -> True, 
    Mass            -> {MH2, 200.}, 
    Width           -> {Wh2, 0.}, 
    PropagatorLabel -> "h2", 
    PropagatorType  -> D, 
    PropagatorArrow -> None, 
    PDG             -> 35, 
    ParticleName    -> "h2", 
    FullName        -> "Heavy Higgs"
  },

  (* Majorana right-handed neutrinos: 3 generations *)
  F[100] == { 
    ClassName        -> NR, 
    ClassMembers     -> {N1, N2, N3}, 
    Indices          -> {Index[Generation]}, 
    FlavorIndex      -> Generation, 
    SelfConjugate    -> True, 
    Mass             -> {MNR, {1400., 1400., 1400.}}, 
    Width            -> {WNR, {0., 0., 0.}}, 
    QuantumNumbers   -> {BL -> -1}, 
    PropagatorLabel  -> {"N", "N1", "N2", "N3"}, 
    PropagatorType   -> Straight, 
    PropagatorArrow  -> Forward, 
    PDG              -> {9990012, 9990014, 9990016}, 
    ParticleName     -> {"N1", "N2", "N3"}, 
    AntiParticleName -> {"N1", "N2", "N3"}, 
    FullName         -> {"Heavy neutrino 1", "Heavy neutrino 2", "Heavy neutrino 3"}
  },

  (* Unphysical scalar: Chi (complex singlet, BL=2) *)
  S[101] == { 
    ClassName      -> Chi, 
    Unphysical     -> True, 
    SelfConjugate  -> False, 
    QuantumNumbers -> {BL -> 2}, 
    Definitions    -> { Chi -> (x + h2 + I*GpBL)/Sqrt[2] } 
  },

  (* Unphysical scalar: Goldstone for Z' *)
  S[102] == { 
    ClassName      -> GpBL, 
    Unphysical     -> True, 
    SelfConjugate  -> True, 
    Goldstone      -> Zp, 
    Mass           -> {MZp, Internal}, 
    Width          -> {WZp, Internal}, 
    QuantumNumbers -> {BL -> 0} 
  }
};

(* ************************** *)
(* *****   Lagrangian   ***** *)
(* ************************** *)

(* Z' kinetic term *)
LZpKin := Block[{mu, nu}, 
  ExpandIndices[-1/4 FS[Zp, mu, nu] FS[Zp, mu, nu]]];

(* Z' mass term is generated by the Higgs mechanism via Chi VEV *)

(* Chi kinetic term with B-L covariant derivative *)
LChiKin := Block[{mu, ii}, 
  ExpandIndices[DC[Chibar[ii], mu] DC[Chi[ii], mu]]];

(* Chi scalar potential from Eq. (2.7) *)
(* V = m^2 H^dagger H + mu^2 |chi|^2 + lambda1 (H^dagger H)^2 + lambda2 |chi|^4 + lambda3 H^dagger H |chi|^2 *)
(* After EWSB and B-L breaking, m^2 = -lambda1 v^2 - lambda3/2 x^2, mu^2 = -lambda2 x^2 - lambda3/2 v^2 *)
LChiPot := Block[{ii, jj}, 
  ExpandIndices[
    -(-lambda1*vev^2 - lambda3/2*x^2) Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] 
    - (-lambda2*x^2 - lambda3/2*vev^2) Chibar[ii] Chi[ii] 
    - lambda1 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] Phibar[jj] Phi[jj] 
    - lambda2 Chibar[ii] Chi[ii] Chibar[jj] Chi[jj] 
    - lambda3 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] Chibar[jj] Chi[jj], 
    FlavorExpand -> {SU2D}]];

(* Right-handed neutrino kinetic term *)
LNRKin := Block[{mu}, 
  ExpandIndices[I*NRbar.Ga[mu].DC[NR, mu]]];

(* Dirac neutrino Yukawa: -y_nu_ij Lbar_i NR_j Htilde + h.c. *)
(* Htilde = i sigma2 H* = -i tau2 H^dagger. In SM.fr: Phibar with Eps contraction *)
LNuYuk := Block[{sp, ii, jj, ff1, ff2}, 
  ExpandIndices[
    -ynu[ff1, ff2] LLbar[sp, ii, ff1].NR[ff2] Phibar[jj] Eps[ii, jj], 
    FlavorExpand -> {SU2D, Generation}]];

(* Majorana neutrino Yukawa: -yM_ij NRbar^c NR_j chi + h.c. *)
(* NRbar^c = CC[NR] = NR^T C. In FeynRules: CC[NR] *)
LNuMYuk := Block[{ff1, ff2}, 
  ExpandIndices[
    -yM[ff1, ff2] CC[NR[ff1]].NR[ff2] Chi, 
    FlavorExpand -> Generation]];

(* Total new physics Lagrangian *)
LTotal := LZpKin + LChiKin + LChiPot + LNRKin + LNuYuk + HC[LNuYuk] + LNuMYuk + HC[LNuMYuk];
